headline: Community preservation funds: $4,550,000 city tax revenue estimate for FY2027 and vote to extend nine older projects.
summary: The agenda includes a $666,120.63 transfer of FY2026 unappropriated funds to the CPA Undesignated account. It also lists a vote on a program manager pay raise.

Community Preservation Committee 
Meeting Agenda 
November 17, 2026 
7:00 p.m. 
 
Pursuant to the relevant legislation, including Mass. Acts 2025 c.2, this meeting will take place remotely. All 
Open Meeting Law requirements will be met and public access will be available by Zoom call. Residents who 
need a device to connect are invited to use a public desktop or borrow a laptop at the Waltham public 
library (valid library card required). 
 
For this meeting, members of the public may participate by joining at: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89137908070?pwd=BGoa0zP6entJrlbbgxOhn8AlbadIS8.1 
Passcode: Waltham 
 
A link to the video recording will be posted as soon as possible after the meeting at: 
https://wcac.org/government/meetings/community-preservation-committee  
 
1.  Call to Order (Chair)  
 
2.  Roll Call (Clerk) 
 
3.  Minutes (Clerk)  
A. Approval of the September 22, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
4.  New Business (Chair) 
A. Vote on CPA Allocations 
1. City Tax Revenue Estimate for FY2027 ($4,550,000) 
2. State Match for FY2027 (TBD) 
3. CPA Unappropriated Balance from FY2026 to the CPA Undesignated account ($666,120.63) 
B. Vote to Extend Older Projects 
1. 92 Felton Street Exterior Renovations (2021) 
2. Waltham Housing Authority Winchester Crane Apts. Window Design (2022) 
3. Arrigo Farm Exterior Restoration (2023) 
4. Opportunities for Inclusion: 15 Fiske Avenue Design Services (2024) 
5. Waltham Housing Authority: Winchester Crane Apts. Window Replacement (2024) 
6. Waltham Boys and Girls Building Renovations (2024) 
7. Stonehurst Design Services (2024) 
8. Opportunities for Inclusion: 15 Fiske Avenue Development (2025) 
9. 260 Grove Street Roof Replacement (2025)  
C. Program Manager Pay Raise 
 
5.  Old Business (Chair)
6.  Announcements/Correspondence (Chair) 
A. Next Meeting: February 16, 2027 
 
7.  Adjourn (Chair)
